description: This file contains utility functions for user authentication, including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth sign-in, sign-out, password update, and error handling, primarily interacting with the Supabase auth API.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user using email and password, setting redirect URL and optional metadata.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified email address.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in a user via a magic link sent to email.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Authenticates a user via an OAuth provider such as Google or GitHub.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors, providing user feedback and redirects based on error type.
